title: FAI Manifest v2 — `mcp_scope` Extension
description: Extension schema validating the optional `mcp_scope` block of `fai-manifest.v2.json`. Declares the federated MCP areas a Solution Play attaches at run-time, plus per-play trust overrides and pre-attach hints. Read by the engine (auto-attach + budget gate), Studio builder (UI dropdown), and Foundry agent (dynamic system prompt).
$comment: License: CC0-1.0. Authored as part of Phase [M0.6] of the FAI MCP Federation Kernel masterplan. Composes WITH `fai-manifest.v2.json` — the parent schema treats `mcp_scope` as `additionalProperties: false`-tolerant via the v2 extension contract. Authored as a standalone schema (rather than mutating the v2 manifest in place) so plays migrate non-breakingly: plays without `mcp_scope` continue to validate.

attached.description: Federated MCP area slugs this play REQUIRES at invocation. Engine attaches each before primitive wiring; refuses to run if any is blocked by trust.

router_config.description: Per-play overrides applied to the shipped trust manifest before evaluation. Only union with user overrides; never replaces them.

trust_overrides.description: Map of publisher slug → trust tier override. Used to elevate `community` to `verified-publisher` for a play the user has already vetted.

pre_attach.description: Subset of `attached` to spawn at engine cold-start (rather than first-use). Trades cold-start latency for first-call latency. Default empty.

detach_on_finish.description: [M10.4] When true, the engine calls `fai_detach_mcp` for every successfully attached area after the run completes. Default false: areas stay attached for the lifetime of the kernel subprocess so repeat invocations reuse warm handles. Set true for ad-hoc / one-shot runs (CI, single-tool extracts) where holding handles open wastes server-side budget.
